commands: set -e; if [ ! -x .deps/luajit/src/luajit ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.1 https://github.com/LuaJIT/LuaJIT.git .deps/luajit; make -C .deps/luajit -j"$(nproc)"; fi; export PATH="$PWD/.deps/luajit/src:$PATH"; make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo CMAKE_EXTRA_FLAGS='-DUSE_BUNDLED=ON' -j"$(nproc)"
